title: Apple Says Former Employee Destroyed Evidence in Data-Theft Case Tied to OpenAI
dek: Apple alleges a former employee destroyed evidence after learning of an investigation into the alleged theft of company data for OpenAI.
socialCaption: Apple says a former employee destroyed evidence after learning of an investigation into alleged theft of company data for OpenAI. The case is a reminder that AI-era talent competition puts offboarding, access logging and evidence preservation under greater scrutiny.
